title: Argentinian Chicken Wraps
description: A fusion of Indian and Argentinian flavors, this spicy chicken wrap is a unique twist on traditional Indian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Indian-Style Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Marinate the chicken in Indian-Style Spices, Lemon Juice, and Winey Garlic Sauce for 30 minutes.
Grill the chicken until cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing sliced chicken, cucumber, tomato, and cilantro on each wrap.
Drizzle with additional Winey Garlic Sauce, if desired.
